notes.title: Update to Demo 5/26/2025 - Fixes
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers,

We've been working hard on polishing the experience — here are the latest changes and additions:

- Added health system with wrist module display.
- Added autosave and load functionality via the menu.
- Added new ability and weapon form selection menus.
- Introduced a new puzzle in the first room.
- Implemented weak points for sword-wielding enemies.
- Added crystals that block certain objects.
- Added an audio archive with extra lore recordings.
- Remote grab now works on climbing platforms.
- Improved remote grab mechanics.
- Adjusted shield activation behavior.
- Updated interactions with Karus.
- Reworked quest sequence inside the temple.
- Tweaked final boss stage.
- Changed flying AI behavior.
- Autopilot now activates during planetary departure.
- Updated visuals for the sandstorm.
- Balanced the number of enemies in the temple.
- Enhanced visual feedback for sound puzzle and ship lock during the boss fight.
- Simplified climbing with an improved climbing assistant.
- Refined tutorial prompts for better clarity.

[previewyoutube=sxs-fKQf1-4;full][/previewyoutube]

Let us know if you spot any bugs or have ideas — we’re listening on Discord, Reddit, and beyond.

Best regards,
ByOwls team

notes.title: Update to Demo 10/11/2024 - Fixes
notes.content:
Greeting adventurers,

We made some changes and fixes, here is the list of the most valued:

- Added haptic response on weapon interaction.
- Changed tutorial a bit, to make it easier to understand.
- Changed AI behavior.
- Rework some collisions.
- Fixed spaceship realistic movement.
- Simplified the climbing way. We would also like to encourage you to use teleport mode for climbing if you are still struggling with assist mode.
- Other small fixes.

Feel free to contact us with any suggestions or if you've encountered bugs. You can reach us on our Discord channel or Reddit page, so leave comments elsewhere — we’re reading all of them.

Best Regards,
ByOwls team
